__comment: The blocks an Electric Network pulls FE from as generators (ADR-0062): Wireworks' tag, filled by the Pack. The tag, not the block's energy face, decides the role: a face that allows extraction is not enough, or any battery or machine would be drained. The pack's Steam Engine (ADR-0077) is its generator; Wireworks tags its own Solar Panel; a part resolves to its anchor before the tag is asked, so only the anchor is listed. A TagKey whose JSON is missing resolves to an empty tag silently, so the file ships rather than being absent.
